name: Salome
overview: Salome is a female follower of Jesus who is noted in the Gospel of Mark as one of the women who accompanied Him from Galilee. Beyond her role as a devoted disciple present at critical moments, Scripture does not provide further personal details about her background or tribe. Her mention highlights the important support and witness role women played in Jesus’ ministry.
namesAndTitles: The name Salome means 'at peace' and is a proper name recorded in Mark 15:40. There is no indication that this name was given by God, but it reflects a common Hebrew name of the period without additional theological significance provided in the text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Salome beyond her identification as one of the women who followed Jesus from Galilee. No other relational details are provided in the biblical record.
scriptureSignificance: Salome’s significance lies in her faithful presence among the women who followed Jesus during His earthly ministry, particularly at the time of His crucifixion. Her inclusion in the Gospel narrative underscores the vital role of female disciples in bearing witness to Jesus’ suffering and resurrection. While details about her life are limited, her mention affirms the diverse group of believers committed to Christ.
